jobs.title: Senior React Developer
jobs.content: <p>Kalesa Labs builds checkout tools for Philippine merchants. We're hiring a Senior React Developer for our hybrid set-up in Makati (3 days in office).</p><h3>What you'll need</h3><ul><li>5+ years of experience building React apps</li><li>TypeScript and testing habits</li></ul><h3>Benefits</h3><ul><li>HMO from day 1 with 2 free dependents</li><li>13th month pay and performance bonus</li><li>Stock options</li></ul><p>Salary: PHP 120,000 - 160,000 per month.</p>
